paper_track_scoring.method: Sum of weights for criteria that are MET or MET_BY_CONSTRUCTION. PARTIAL/OPEN/BLOCKED contribute 0 to the EVIDENCE-BACKED score (they are not objective launch evidence). Reported as a range, not a single fabricated number.
paper_track_scoring.interpretation: 53% of the weighted paper-track criteria have objective launch evidence. The remaining 47% is PARTIAL (quota real-Redis, tenant RLS depth) or BLOCKED/OPEN (sandbox E2E, reconciliation). This is a READINESS figure, NOT an implementation figure: most of the code is implemented, but the launch-critical EVIDENCE (venue-sandbox E2E, operational reconciliation) does not exist.

why_no_single_overall_percentage: A single blended percentage across implementation + paper + live + production would hide the two facts that actually decide launch: (1) the paper-launch EVIDENCE gates for venue-sandbox E2E and reconciliation are not satisfied, and (2) live/production have no evidence at all. Averaging them into one number would manufacture false confidence. The per-track figures above keep implementation and evidence separate and keep BLOCKED/OPEN out of the pass count.
